# Phase 3 proposed approval corpus

Status: awaiting owner approval. These are small synthetic inputs for the new
migration acceptance instrument, not runtime observations or completed gates.
The invented tests/source.py and tests/current.py coordinates and repeated hex
digests are fixture values. They are never claimed as real source provenance.

Read each story in inputs.json, then its separately stored expected verdict and
named reason in answers.json. G00 is the current accepting control; negative
siblings change one property. G13 is an exclusively historical identity with no
handoff, and G14 is an explicitly adapted current successor. Every rejecting
case has a specific cause; an unrelated failure is not a matching answer.

The corpus covers newly introduced mapping, collection, optional-claim and
handoff checks. Existing runtime assertions retain their original or independently
reviewed current oracles. This corpus does not substitute for the 5,331-definition
assertion disposition, expanded collection or functional workflow acceptance.
No harness has run. No blind pass, owner reading or current result is claimed.

Owner steering adds G16/G17 to distinguish justified consolidation from silent
coverage loss, and G18 to refuse a closure with private nested fixture content.
All markers are invented. The 5,331 originals require accounting, not 5,331 public
test definitions; target metadata must itself be cleared for publication.
